description: Work a Productive.io board without leaving BB, and hand a ticket to an agent in one click. Kanban lanes group by workflow status or by task list, so the columns match the board you already use, and dragging a card writes the change back to Productive. Start a thread from any ticket, optionally in its own git worktree, with the ticket's fields as context. Agents reach the same board through a `bb productive` command. Needs a Productive.io account and an API token.
